trace.environment: placeholder capabilities; no omitted actor is implicitly excluded

trace.continuity: requires post/pre correspondence at every retained boundary

Required.definition: PLACEHOLDER task-state requirement independent of what the UI displays; Actions={exit}.

Discoverable.definition: PLACEHOLDER a named affordance is visually and assistively exposed and reachable from current focus within h=2 legal keyboard navigation actions, including modal restrictions. Rendering and assistive correspondence are unproved.

readings.body: forall sigma in Traces: forall a in Actions: always(Required(a) => Discoverable(a))
readings.intuitive: every required action remains discoverable at every recorded UI event
